title: Upcoming IPOs, Explained Simply — July 2026
description: Knack Packaging Limited's Mainboard IPO is closing today, July 3rd. IC Electricals Company Limited's SME IPO opens today, July 3rd.

faq.q: How do I even apply for an IPO?
faq.a: You can apply for an IPO through your bank's net banking portal using the ASBA (Application Supported by Blocked Amount) facility, or directly through your stockbroker's trading platform. You will need a Demat account and a trading account.
The lot size is the minimum number of shares you must apply for in an IPO. You cannot apply for a single share; you must apply in multiples of this lot size.

faq.q: What is the difference between a Mainboard IPO and an SME IPO?
faq.a: Mainboard IPOs are typically for larger, more established companies, and their shares trade on the main exchanges (NSE, BSE). SME IPOs are for smaller companies, and their shares trade on dedicated SME platforms (like NSE Emerge or BSE SME), which have different listing and trading rules.

faq.q: Can I apply for less than the minimum lot size?
faq.a: No, you cannot. You must apply for at least one lot, and then in multiples of that lot size. Your application will be rejected if you bid for fewer shares than the lot size.

faq.q: What happens if I don't get any shares in the allotment?
faq.a: If you are not allotted any shares, the money you applied with (which was blocked in your bank account) will be unblocked and returned to you, usually within a few days after the allotment process is complete.
